title: MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging
summary: Model merging consolidates task-specialized experts into a single deployable model. However, we show that such capability consolidation incurs a merging tax of increased hallucination: across 8 model-merging methods, every merged checkpoint exhibits a higher hallucination rate than the average of its constituent experts. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing hallucination-mitigation methods to the post-merge model, yet this unconstrained adaptation disrupts inherited capabilities, creating a tension between hallucination mitigation and expertise retention. To tackle this challenge, we introduce MergeHEIR, a post-merge adaptation framework designed to reduce this merging tax while preserving expertise inherited from initial experts. Using small expert-task calibration sets, MergeHEIR constructs layer-wise null-space projectors via SVD from task-specific activations collected from the merged checkpoint, and periodically projects the accumulated post-merge displacement onto the resulting null spaces to preserve inherited expertise. Theoretically, we establish minimum-distortion and maximum-dimensionality guarantees, characterize the threshold-controlled adaptation-retention trade-off, and extend perturbation guarantees beyond finite calibration data. Across 24 paired comparisons spanning three MLLM configurations and 8 model-merging methods, MergeHEIR consistently mitigates hallucination while largely preserving inherited expertise, demonstrating a more favorable hallucination-retention trade-off.

AI.tldr: 模型合并将任务专业化专家整合为单一可部署模型，但会导致"合并税"——幻觉率增加。现有幻觉缓解方法会破坏继承的专业能力。MergeHEIR通过在任务特定激活上使用SVD构建层-wise零空间投影器，定期将累积的合并后位移投影到零空间以保留继承的专业知识。
AI.motivation: 模型合并 consolidation 会产生幻觉率增加的"合并税"，且现有幻觉缓解方法会破坏继承的专业能力，在幻觉缓解与专业知识保留之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: MergeHEIR使用小型专家任务校准集，从合并检查点的任务特定激活中通过SVD构建层-wise零空间投影器，并将累积的合并后位移定期投影到零空间以保留继承的专业知识。
AI.result: 在24个配对比较中（3个MLLM配置和8种模型合并方法），MergeHEIR持续缓解幻觉同时基本保留继承的专业知识，展现更有利的幻觉-保留权衡。
AI.conclusion: MergeHEIR提供了一种有效的后合并适应框架，在缓解幻觉的同时保留继承的专业能力，为模型合并中的幻觉-保留权衡问题提供了理论保证和实证验证。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.conclusion: TriO通过多模态自监督学习范式，成功实现了无需人工标注的开放集障碍物分割，有效解决了长尾物体分割难题，为无监督自动驾驶感知提供了新思路。

title: PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins
summary: The harness surrounding a language model is a central determinant of agent performance. Recent methods optimize harnesses by searching over complete programs, where individual mechanisms are difficult to isolate and reuse. We introduce PluginRSI, which represents a harness as a composition of atomized plugins and organizes harness evolution around these plugins. Individual plugins are improved independently and accumulated in a shared library, then recombined into new harnesses at each iteration. PluginRSI improves over existing harness optimization methods across software engineering, command-line interaction, and question-answering tasks. The resulting harnesses retain their advantage when transferred to other solver models without further optimization. The evolved plugin library accelerates subsequent optimization from the initial harness, which helps faster and higher convergence on unseen tasks. These results show that accumulating reusable mechanisms provides an effective basis for continued harness improvement.

AI.tldr: PluginRSI将语言模型的harness表示为原子化插件的组合，通过独立改进插件并将其积累在共享库中，然后在每次迭代中重新组合成新的harness。这种方法在软件工程、命令行交互和问答任务上优于现有harness优化方法，且生成的harness可迁移到其他模型，插件库还能加速后续优化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过搜索完整程序来优化harness，但这种方法难以隔离和重用单个机制。作者希望将harness分解为可独立改进和重复使用的模块化组件。
AI.method: 将harness表示为原子化插件的组合；独立改进单个插件并积累在共享库中；每次迭代时将插件重新组合成新的harness。
AI.result: 在软件工程、命令行交互和问答任务上优于现有harness优化方法；生成的harness可迁移到其他求解器模型而无需进一步优化；进化后的插件库加速后续优化，在未见任务上实现更快更高的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 积累可重用机制为持续改进harness提供了有效基础。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Depth Any Seen方法，将可见表面表示为图像条件化的多伯努利深度集，并提出Exact Multi-Bernoulli目标函数学习深度和存在估计。实验表明该方法在层析深度基准上显著减少过预测，同时保持深度准确性。

title: Authorization Closure Graph: Minimal Repair for LLM Agents with Evolving User Instructions
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents increasingly perform state-changing actions that require user authorization. Yet existing approaches do not provide a principled mechanism for selectively updating prior authorization when only part of an instruction changes. To this end, we propose an Authorization-Closure-Graph (ACG)-based framework that represents authorization and its dependencies as an evolving, versioned state. ACG selectively invalidates authority affected by a revision while preserving unaffected portions of the authorization state, and computes a minimal repair that identifies only the missing evidence or authority required for execution. This enables agents to adapt to revised instructions while avoiding stale authority and unnecessary authorization requests. We evaluate ACG across three advanced LLMs in two natural tasks, and ACG consistently improves action safety rate and task success rate. Code is available at https://github.com/weiliang822/ACG.

AI.tldr: 提出了Authorization-Closure-Graph (ACG)框架,用于解决工具使用型LLM代理在指令部分变更时选择性更新授权的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏在指令部分变更时选择性更新授权的原则性机制,导致代理可能持有过期权限或提出不必要的授权请求。
AI.method: ACG将授权及其依赖关系表示为演进式版本化状态,选择性使受修订影响的权限失效,同时保留未受影响的授权部分,并计算最小修复方案以识别仅需的缺失证据或权限。
AI.result: 在三个先进LLM和两个自然任务中的评估表明,ACG持续提高了行动安全率和任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: ACG框架能使代理适应修订后的指令,同时避免过期权限和不必要的授权请求。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ScreenHaystack是一个用于评估GUI grounding空间可靠性的动态"大海捞针"基准测试。通过将目标图标系统性地重新定位到高分辨率GUI背景上，发现主流模型(Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus)存在"盲区"——即空间区域中定位精度急剧下降。这些盲区会转移到未见的ScreenSpot-Pro样本上，Qwen3-VL-8B精度下降16.1个百分点。训练数据空间覆盖不均是导致盲区的原因，提出盲区导向增强策略可提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的GUI grounding评估基准存在局限性：它们在固定位置测试每个目标，无法揭示模型在不同空间位置上的可靠性差异。实际应用中，GUI元素可能出现在屏幕任意位置，因此评估模型的空间一致性至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 构建ScreenHaystack基准：将目标图标系统性地重新定位到高分辨率GUI背景上，测试模型能否一致地定位目标；2) 量化分析盲区：通过控制变量实验验证盲区的存在及可迁移性；3) 合成实验：验证训练数据空间覆盖不均与盲区的因果关系；4) 提出盲区导向增强策略：在盲区添加监督信号进行微调。
AI.result: 1) 主流GUI grounding模型均存在盲区，空间精度急剧下降；2) 盲区可迁移至ScreenSpot-Pro未见过样本，Qwen3-VL-8B精度下降16.1个百分点；3) 受控位移实验证实：移入盲区精度下降，移出盲区精度提升；4) 训练数据空间覆盖不均可导致盲区；5) 盲区导向增强策略在ScreenSpot-Pro上超越原始和随机增强的Click-100k微调效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了当前领先GUI grounding模型存在空间盲区这一重要问题，证实了训练数据分布与模型空间可靠性的关联，并提出盲区导向增强作为有效解决方案，为提升GUI交互模型的鲁棒性提供了新思路。

title: PrismQuant: Optimal Null-Space Rotations for Grouped Quantizers
comment: The paper is currently under review. Code, checkpoints, and implementation details are available at: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant
summary: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. Experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral span dense models up to 70B parameters and a 30B mixture-of-experts model. Under W4A4KV4, PrismQuant sets the state of the art on Llama-3.2-3B among the compared methods in both perplexity and accuracy. On Llama-3.1-70B, it attains 3.85 perplexity and 72.46% average zero-shot accuracy, only 0.22 percentage points below full precision. In the deployment study on Llama-3.1-8B, our optimized implementation achieves 1.51x prefill and 1.22x CUDA Graph decode speedups over matched FP16 baselines, with 56.34% lower decode peak memory and only 2.35% additional Graph decode latency over Hadamard. Code is available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant.

AI.tldr: PrismQuant是一个量化感知的旋转框架,通过对齐激活特征空间与非对称分组INT4的常数子空间来改进低比特量化。该方法将旋转设计表述为Ky Fan迹最大化问题,并推导出封闭形式的最优解。
AI.motivation: 现有方法认为较小的激活异常值意味着更好的低比特量化,但作者指出这种观点忽略了异常值与量化器的对齐问题。关键在于激活能量是否与量化器的常数子空间对齐,而非仅看异常值大小。
AI.method: 1)提出对齐领先激活特征空间与非对称分组INT4常数子空间的框架;2)将旋转设计表述为Ky Fan迹最大化,推导出封闭形式最优解;3)使用紧凑Householder变换及其WY表示实现无梯度构造和高效应用;4)建立预测范围定律,连接未对齐激活能量、组大小与量化相关变化。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-3B上W4A4KV4设置SOTA;Llama-3.1-70B达到3.85困惑度和72.46%平均零样本准确率,仅比全精度低0.22个百分点;Llama-3.1-8B部署实现1.51倍prefill加速和1.22倍CUDA Graph解码加速,峰值内存降低56.34%。
AI.conclusion: PrismQuant通过量化感知的旋转对齐方法,在保持竞争力的量化性能同时显著提升推理效率,为大型语言模型的低比特量化提供了新的有效途径。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

AI.tldr: ControlGS是一个面向扩展现实(XR)的Gaussian渲染管道,通过建模整个下游处理流程(从渲染输出到人眼)来优化端到端视觉质量,并能根据运行时下游处理参数动态生成Gaussian基元。
AI.motivation: XR用户无法直接看到渲染引擎的输出,图像需要经过后处理管道和物理显示-光学路径才能到达人眼。下游处理可能在运行时发生显著变化(如相机姿态、显示功率预算),传统3DGS方法要么隐含假设下游处理保持图像质量,要么无法适应下游处理的变化。
AI.method: ControlGS将渲染输出和人眼之间的整个下游处理流程建模并集成到优化目标中。为适应运行时下游处理,ControlGS根据下游处理参数动态生成Gaussian基元。实验在不同的神经Gaussian主干网络和数据集上进行了验证。
AI.result: ControlGS在不同的神经Gaussian主干网络和数据集上始终改善了端到端后光学XR质量,且具有 minimal overhead(最小开销)。
AI.conclusion: ControlGS能够有效适应XR渲染中下游处理的变化,为解决传统3DGS方法无法适应运行时参数变化的问题提供了新思路。

title: Multi-Agent System Search via Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization
summary: LLMs enable multi-agent systems (MAS) to tackle complex tasks, but manually designing agent roles, prompts, and communication structures requires substantial expertise and effort. This motivates learning policies that construct query-specific MAS from execution reward. Existing approaches typically train these policies by repeatedly traversing a fixed set of training queries and assigning rewards at the workflow level. However, this overlooks differences in queries' evolving learning potential and obscures which substructures improve solution quality. In this paper, we propose Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization (ASPO), a RL framework for query-level MAS search. ASPO introduces an Adaptive Query-Selection Mechanism (AQSM) that focuses training on queries at the policy's competence boundary: those it can solve but not yet reliably. A complementary discovery mechanism widens architectural exploration for hard queries, helping distinguish insufficient exploration from operator capability limits. Beyond query selection, ASPO introduces substructure-level rewards that measure output-quality gains within each action's descendant subgraph. These rewards guide proximal policy optimization to reinforce useful architectural refinements and discourage redundant or harmful computation. Together, these mechanisms prioritize learnable queries and provide fine-grained feedback for learning effective MASs. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, general question answering, and code generation, ASPO ranks first on every benchmark against twelve baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPO框架，通过自适应查询选择机制和子结构级奖励来优化多智能体系统的构建策略，在6个基准测试中排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有方法手动设计智能体角色、提示和通信结构需要大量专业知识；现有强化学习方法对所有训练查询统一对待，忽略查询的学习潜力差异，且仅在workflow层面分配奖励，无法识别哪些子结构真正提升了解决方案质量。

AI.result: 在6个涵盖数学推理、通用问答和代码生成的基准测试中，ASPO在所有基准上排名第一，超越了12个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ASPO通过优先处理可学习的查询并提供细粒度反馈，有效学习构建高效的多智能体系统，为查询级MAS搜索提供了一种新的强化学习范式。

title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
summary: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

title: From Latents to Wires: Surgical Post-Editing on Large Language Models
summary: Given a large language model (LLM), can whoever holds the weights name a semantic target (e.g., the model's identity), locate the model components that produce it, and edit them so that the target no longer appears while other capability is preserved? We call such an edit on a trained model a post-edit. We present L2W (latents to wires), a framework that performs surgical post-edits for named semantic targets. For localization, L2W uses Jacobian lens (J-lens) attribution to score components against the semantic target. For surgical removal, because LLM mechanisms are redundant (i.e., a semantic target may have multiple components producing it), L2W runs Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC) until the target no longer appears. CGCC first cumulatively closes model components, treating each surviving expression of the target as a counterexample that exposes the next components to close, and then reopens some of them to preserve capability. In a controlled experiment with an implanted behavioural watermark, L2W removes the watermark, and its localization lands on the model region the implant changed. Across three model configurations, L2W removes model-metadata (e.g., identity) self-claims in all nine runs, and adult-content refusal in all three, with no held-out target residual. L2W further composes two post-edits on a text-to-image model: one removes the refusal of requested nudity, and a second removes the nude rendering the first exposes. The results support post-editing as a complement to post-training: post-training installs preferred behaviours, and post-editing removes named unwanted ones.

AI.tldr: 提出L2W框架，实现对训练后大型语言模型进行精确的语义目标移除手术式后编辑，包括定位和删除模型中特定语义特征（如身份标识、拒绝行为等），同时保留其他能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型可能包含不希望的行为或信息（如模型身份自我声明、内容拒绝等），需要一种方法能够在不重新训练的情况下精确移除这些特定语义目标，同时保持模型的其他功能。
AI.method: 提出L2W（latents to wires）框架，包含两个核心组件：1）J-lens（Jacobian lens）归因定位，用于评分模型组件与语义目标的相关性；2）CGCC（Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut）因果切割算法，通过累积关闭模型组件来消除目标，将每个 surviving 表达式作为暴露下一个需关闭组件的counterexample，最后重新打开部分组件以保留能力。
AI.result: 在植入行为水印的受控实验中，L2W成功移除水印，定位到模型被修改的区域；在三个模型配置中，9次实验全部移除模型元数据（如身份）自我声明，3次实验全部移除成人内容拒绝，且无残留目标；文本到图像模型上成功组合两个后编辑：一个移除对裸体的拒绝，第二个移除裸露渲染。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: ReFM是一种基于能量引导的源mesh无关的运动重定向模型，将运动重定向问题重新表述为渐进式优化过程。该方法通过SO(3)标准化器和对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器来解决无配对数据情况下的语义学习问题，并可兼容多种初始化策略。
AI.motivation: 解决运动重定向中的两个根本问题：(1)如何在没有高质量配对重定向数据的情况下学习可靠的源运动语义；(2)如何在没有可靠配对运动作为回归目标时进行重定向。现有方法通过约束预测向复制运动来保留语义，但这会将有用 articulation cues与骨骼比例和身体几何不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起。此外，直接单次前向回归最终运动具有局限性，因为重定向本质上是不确定性问题。
AI.method: 提出ReFM框架，包含：(1)SO(3)标准化器移除冗余的全局方向变化；(2)跨角色语义编码器通过对比学习预训练，提供字符不变表示用于优化指导和语义评估；(3)通过学习的流进行渐进式细化，引导因素包括语义一致性、物理 plausibility、时间一致性和最小运动修改。框架兼容不同初始化策略，包括直接运动复制和Autodesk HumanIK。
AI.result: 该方法实现了源mesh无关的运动重定向，通过渐进式优化平衡语义保真度与目标特定物理和时间约束。
AI.conclusion: ReFM通过将运动重定向重新表述为渐进式细化问题，结合对比学习语义编码器和多目标能量引导，有效解决了无配对数据下的语义学习难题，并可兼容多种初始化策略，具有良好的通用性和实用性。

title: Controllable GNN Explanations via Multi-Metric Preference Selection
summary: Mechanisms for generating GNN explanations are crucial for building trust and mitigating biases in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), especially in high-stakes scenarios. Most current methods optimize only for fidelity under the sparsity constraint. However, this discounts the need for interpretable explanations (those that consist of familiar motif patterns) and stable explanations (those that remain unchanged under structural perturbations). We propose a novel approach that optimizes GNN explanations across these metrics, exposing their relative weighing as a control. Experiments on various real-world datasets, including MUTAG, BA-2Motif, BAMultiShapes, and PROTEINS, suggest that our method produces higher-fidelity explanations than a state-of-the-art baseline on MUTAG and PROTEINS across all evaluated budgets, and on BA-2Motif at larger budgets, while being faster in the regime of small explanation budgets. We also explore how, given an input motif library containing standard motifs for the corresponding domain, the method can be used to determine the relative importance of those motifs in generating the explanations, and how this information can be used to further improve the quality of the output explanations. We also examine the relationship between different metrics through their induced tradeoff surface, and explore its dependence on the nature of the motif library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的GNN解释方法，能够在保真度、可解释性和稳定性三个指标之间进行权衡优化。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上优于现有SOTA方法，特别是在小预算情况下速度更快。
AI.motivation: 当前GNN解释方法仅优化保真度指标，忽视了可解释性（熟悉 motif 模式）和稳定性（结构扰动下保持不变）的需求，这在高风险场景中可能导致信任问题和偏见。
AI.method: 提出一种新方法，在多个指标上优化GNN解释，通过暴露相对权重作为控制参数，实现保真度、可解释性和稳定性之间的权衡。使用包含标准motif的输入motif库来确定各motif的相对重要性。
AI.result: 在MUTAG、PROTEINS数据集的所有预算下，以及BA-2Motif在大预算下均获得更高保真度解释；在小预算情况下速度更快。还探索了不同指标之间的权衡曲面及其与motif库性质的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效生成高质量GNN解释，通过可控的权重调整实现不同指标间的权衡，为理解GNN行为和缓解偏见提供了有力工具。

title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于2D高斯表示的信息隐写方法，通过在高斯参数（对数各向异性、不透明度、颜色亮度）中嵌入8比特消息，实现高保真图像重建和密钥安全传输。
AI.motivation: 传统的像素级隐写术容易被检测，而2D高斯表示作为新兴的图像表示方法，具有连续可微的参数特性，为隐写提供了新的载体空间。
AI.method: 1) 将目标图像拟合成2D高斯参数表示；2) 使用密钥选择部分高斯参数进行微调以嵌入8比特消息；3) 对比随机选择与最小干扰选择两种嵌入策略；4) 在合成图像和自然图像上验证方法有效性。
AI.result: 合成图像：30次实验正确密钥恢复无误，错误密钥BER为0.543接近随机猜测；最小干扰选择策略显著优于随机选择(p=0.031)，平均PSNR损失仅0.091dB。自然图像：112张256×256图像，4,096个高斯，正确密钥BER=0.000，错误密钥BER=0.520接近随机。三参数类型均可嵌入payload，减少至两参数类型时正确密钥仍无误码。
AI.conclusion: 基于2D高斯参数的信息隐写方法可行且安全，正确密钥可100%恢复消息，错误密钥接近随机猜测，视觉质量损失极小，具有实际应用潜力。

The research profile focuses on 3D motion generation from 2D video priors, video generation models (Wanxiang, Seedance), VLM-based quality supervision, and bridging 2D video to 3D motion. While both mention "2D Gaussians," this paper uses Gaussians as a carrier for hiding secret messages (security/application), not for video generation or motion synthesis. The application domain is entirely different - this is computer security/hiding rather than computer graphics for motion/video generation.

title: ForkLeft: Entropy-First Rollouts for Prefix-Aligned Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Distillation
summary: Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has enabled strong reasoning capabilities in language models, while Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible token orders and parallel generation. We ask whether DLMs can acquire NTP-style reasoning through distillation without giving up their native generation process. Direct distillation, however, faces a fundamental mismatch: an autoregressive teacher predicts from a left prefix, whereas a DLM can condition on tokens on both sides. We introduce ForkLeft, a distillation framework that resolves this mismatch by separating the student's rollout from teacher supervision. During training, the student first performs entropy-first rollouts that commit uncertain positions and expose potential forks. We then fix the resulting student prefix and distill an NTP teacher under the same context, with answer correctness determining the supervision source. At inference, the student returns to its native confidence-first parallel decoding. With Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ForkLeft improves Efficient-DLM-4B on all ten benchmarks, raising MATH500 from 72.60% to 79.60% and consistently outperforming three alternative designs. The gains scale with teacher strength and generalize to SDAR-4B with only $500$ updates. At matched scale, the distilled 4B and 8B students exceed the published SDAR-Chat and OPDLM models on seven benchmarks, showing that DLMs can learn NTP-style reasoning without sacrificing native parallel generation. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForkLeft框架，使扩散语言模型（DLM）能够通过蒸馏学习自回归下一个token预测（NTP）风格的推理能力，同时保留其原生并行生成能力。核心创新是分离学生 rollout 与教师监督，使用熵优先 rollout 暴露分叉点，再在固定前缀下蒸馏 NTP 教师。
AI.motivation: 自回归NTP模型具有强大的推理能力，而扩散语言模型支持灵活的token顺序和并行生成。研究旨在让DLM获得NTP式推理能力，同时不放弃其原生并行生成流程。直接蒸馏面临根本性 mismatch：自回归教师从左前缀预测，而DLM可以同时 conditioning 两边的token。
AI.method: ForkLeft框架核心步骤：1）训练时学生先执行熵优先rollout，提交不确定位置并暴露潜在分叉；2）固定学生前缀，在相同上下文下蒸馏NTP教师；3）答案正确性决定监督来源。推理时学生回归原生置信度优先的并行解码。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base，ForkLeft在所有10个基准上提升Efficient-DLM-4B，MATH500从72.60%提升至79.60%，连续超越三种替代设计。收益随教师强度扩大，泛化至SDAR-4B仅需500次更新。匹配规模下，蒸馏的4B和8B学生模型在7个基准上超越SDAR-Chat和OPDLM。
AI.conclusion: DLM可以通过蒸馏学习NTP式推理能力，同时不牺牲原生并行生成。证明两种生成范式可以有效融合，为构建同时具备强大推理和高效并行生成能力的语言模型提供了新思路。

While both involve "diffusion models," the application domains are entirely different - this is about text/LLMs while the profile needs video generation and 2D-to-3D motion synthesis. title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: CausalDriveBench是一个基于Pearl因果层次(PCH)的评估框架，用于测试自动驾驶中视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的因果推理能力。该基准包含7,285个因果问答对和1,000个反事实轨迹，评估13个模型后发现最佳模型仅达到70.6%准确率，且因果问答与轨迹准确性统计上不相关。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型虽然能生成自然语言推理和预测轨迹，但这些推理是否反映场景的因果结构仍未被测试。现有评估缺乏对因果理解的系统验证。
AI.method: 构建基于nuScenes的因果场景图，区分因果活跃、潜伏和干扰实体；在PCH的所有四个层级（关联、干预、反事实及因果发现）生成问答对；为高层级提供参考轨迹进行动作级验证。
AI.result: 最佳模型仅达70.6%问答准确率，4/13模型低于随机水平；驾驶微调导致因果问答准确率下降2-34个百分点；因果问答与轨迹准确性统计上不相关，轨迹预测要么过度反应要么塌陷到观察基线。
AI.conclusion: 流利的理由或准确的观察场景轨迹不足以证明因果理解，当前VLA模型缺乏真正的因果推理能力，需要重新审视模型设计。

title: PULSE: Identifying Demonstration-Utility Features with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: In-context learning is highly sensitive to demonstration choice, yet most methods select demonstrations using external query-demonstration similarity. Such criteria can miss model-specific signals: Similar demonstrations may activate different internal features and downstream behaviors. We introduce PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings), an SAE-based framework for identifying model-internal features associated with demonstration utility and using them for demonstration selection. Using a small labeled discovery set, PULSE samples candidate demonstration sets, measures their zero-shot-relative utility under the target model, and scores SAE features by how their activation differences align with utility differences. The top positive and negative coordinates form a sparse utility-localization vector. We use this vector in two complementary ways: as a signed score for controlled complete-set ranking, and as PULSE-Retriever, which converts its magnitude into a feature-relevance mask for scalable pool-scale retrieval. Across classification, generation, and reasoning benchmarks, PULSE-Retriever improves over the strongest baseline by 2-3 accuracy points, 0.6-0.9 BLEU-4, and 3.2 exact-match points, respectively, while controlled ranking validates the identified features encode a predictive set-level utility signal. Feature inspection and cross-dataset experiments suggest that the identified features capture task-relevant, dataset-conditioned patterns, yet retain utility signals that partially transfer across datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/aohenuo/PULSE.

AI.tldr: PULSE是一种基于稀疏自编码器(SAE)的框架，用于识别与演示实用性相关的模型内部特征，并利用这些特征进行演示选择。该方法通过小规模标注发现集对候选演示集进行采样，测量目标模型下的零样本相对实用性，并根据激活差异对齐实用性差异来评分SAE特征。
AI.motivation: 当前演示选择方法主要依赖外部的查询-演示相似度，但这种方法可能遗漏模型特定的信号：相似的演示可能激活不同的内部特征和下游行为。
AI.method: PULSE框架包括：1）使用小规模标注发现集采样候选演示集；2）测量目标模型下的零样本相对实用性；3）根据激活差异对齐实用性差异来评分SAE特征；4）使用顶部正负坐标形成稀疏实用性定位向量；5）将该向量用作可控完整集排名的签名分数，或转换为特征相关性掩码用于大规模检索池扩展检索(PULSE-Retriever)。
AI.result: 在分类、生成和推理基准测试中，PULSE-Retriever分别比最强基线提高2-3个准确点、0.6-0.9个BLEU-4和3.2个精确匹配点。控制排名验证了识别出的特征编码了预测性的集合级实用性信号。
AI.conclusion: 特征检查和跨数据集实验表明，识别出的特征捕获了任务相关、数据集条件的模式，同时保留了可在数据集间部分迁移的实用性信号。

While both involve "features" and "retrieval", the application domains are entirely different: the research profile focuses on video-to-3D motion generation, quality control for video generation, and visual guidance extraction, whereas this paper addresses LLM model optimization through demonstration utility identification. The method (SAE for LLM interpretability) is also unrelated to the specified methods (video generation models like Wanxiang/Seedance, VLMs, and 3D motion generation models).

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PruneForget方法，将机器遗忘和模型剪枝联合求解。核心思想是编码待遗忘样本信息的参数自然成为剪枝目标，因为遗忘和剪枝都旨在"删除"这些参数。实验在图像分类器和生成模型上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中模型需要同时支持遗忘请求(如安全考虑)和满足延迟与内存预算要求。之前研究将遗忘和剪枝作为独立问题分别处理，缺乏联合优化方案。
AI.method: PruneForget利用待遗忘样本作为剪枝引导，将编码遗忘样本信息的参数作为自然剪枝目标，使遗忘和剪枝相互促进。
AI.result: 在图像分类器和生成模型上的广泛实验表明，PruneForget在消除遗忘样本影响的同时产生更紧凑的模型，降低推理成本。与先从头重训练再剪枝的oracle方法相比，性能差距可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘和剪枝天然对齐，应联合求解。PruneForget实现了与oracle方法相当的性能，同时显著降低了计算开销。

relevance_reason: This paper addresses machine learning model optimization (unlearning and pruning), which is completely unrelated to the research profile focused on Computer Graphics for 3D motion generation from 2D video priors. While both deal with "vision models," the application domain is entirely different - one is about model compression for efficiency, the other is about video-to-3D motion synthesis. The methods and goals have no overlap with the stated pain points of quality control, visual guidance extraction, or bridging 2D-3D motion generation.

title: VPEvolve: A Self-Evolving Virtual Process Engineer for Computational Lithography
summary: Optical proximity correction (OPC) recipes grow as engineers add local rules to repair newly discovered lithography hotspots. Each correction can interact with existing rules, while lessons from commercial-tool trials remain scattered across code and logs. \system combines a Virtual Process Engineer (VPE) harness with a Skill Bank of measured engineering experience. The harness equips a frozen language model with process manuals, layout analysis, recipe editing, and commercial-tool evaluation. The actor proposes changes to the global parameters, local targeted rules, or diagnostic trials. After each evaluation, an LLM reflector and curator turn the measured response into evidence-linked judgments. The actor retrieves them before its next trial. Feasible improvements update the retained recipe; every measured trial informs the Skill Bank that guides the next edit. The model weights remain fixed. On a FreePDK45-derived benchmark with ten commercial-tool evaluations per case, \system reduces the mean per-case maximum edge placement error from 18.294 to 5.361 nm on Poly and from 22.052 to 15.692 nm on Metal1. Every final recipe satisfies the predefined quality constraints and improves the maximum error by at least 0.1 nm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合虚拟工艺工程师（VPE）框架和技能库的自动光刻邻近效应校正（OPC）配方优化系统，通过冻结语言模型自动调整全局参数、局部规则和诊断试验，在FreePDK45基准上将Poly和Metal1层的最大边缘放置误差分别降低至5.361nm和15.692nm。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

AI.tldr: PQR3D是一种用于纯相机多视角3D目标检测的流式检测器，通过在参考条件时间窗口内进行渐进式查询精炼，实现随机帧采样和独立推理，无需持久查询内存。

AI.method: 1) 参考条件时间窗口内的渐进式查询精炼：从早期时间戳逐步转移运动对齐的高置信度查询到目标帧；2) 掩码自注意力：调节常规、传播和去噪查询之间的交互，同时将去噪监督与检测查询隔离；3) 阶段解耦锚点嵌入：在自注意力前注入位置，之后注入尺寸、方向和速度，减少时间不一致属性的干扰。
AI.result: 在nuScenes测试集上，使用ViT-L骨干网络，达到了71.6 NDS和64.9 mAP的性能。
AI.conclusion: PQR3D在纯相机多视角3D目标检测任务上建立了新的最先进水平，验证了渐进式查询精炼和参考条件时间窗口设计的有效性。

title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.

AI.tldr: SURE框架通过学习和利用相对策略效用来改进数学推理，将高级策略与详细推理分离，使用策略奖励模型估计相对策略效用，并将其与正确性和格式奖励结合到序列级GRPO目标中。
AI.motivation: 当前具有可验证奖励的强化学习仅考虑最终正确性，无法深入了解高级策略（如定理选择和子目标分解）的质量，因为它们与后续执行分离后无法单独评估。
AI.method: 提出策略效用概念，定义为在给定执行器下策略支持正确下游解决方案的可能性。框架分离高级策略与详细推理，基于策略条件 rollout 和教师生成的对比构建成对偏好，学习策略奖励模型估计相对策略效用。在强化学习阶段，冻结的奖励模型仅读取提取的策略，将其得分与正确性和格式奖励结合到序列级GRPO目标中。
AI.result: 在三个策略骨干网上，平均pass@1分别提升1.87%、2.64%和2.93%。与更强的奖励基线相比，具有竞争力或更好的准确性，同时需要显著更少的GRPO阶段计算资源。
AI.conclusion: SURE通过学习和利用策略效用有效改进数学推理，在更少计算成本下实现更好性能。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: OneFixer是一种用于3D高斯溅射(3DGS)渲染的一步自回归视频扩散修复器,通过单一任务特定自适应阶段训练,在自动驾驶模拟中实现低延迟、高视觉质量和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 一步因果生成中,每个不完美的预测会立即成为后续帧的上下文,导致误差累积。现有方法通过多阶段训练和 rollout 正则化来稳定 rollout,但一步质量仍不满足部署要求。
AI.method: 核心思路是"部署匹配的共享 rollout":模型自身的一步预测作为流匹配的因果上下文,使训练暴露于部署时误差;同一 rollout 接收直接的像素空间感知监督以保留细节。利用驾驶模拟提供的车道几何和动态代理状态线索提高几何保真度。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 和专有驾驶场景的 900 帧 rollout 上,OneFixer 在一步条件下实现最低的 FVD、LPIPS 和 DISTS,时间一致性达到或超过多阶段 DMD 管道。在相同骨干和条件下,OneFixer 以不到一半的 GPU 小时数匹配多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing 管道,并持续改进。
AI.conclusion: OneFixer 能够将保真度和自回归鲁棒性联合学习,无需双向到因果转换或师生蒸馏。在与驾驶策略的闭环模拟中,OneFixer 将碰撞率降低三分之一。

title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

AI.tldr: DMD-EEG提出双视图多尺度脑电变形方法，将头皮光谱专家（用于诊断）与源空间疾病相关表示（低秩稀疏迭代变形）分离，在46个ROI×5频率×4滞后的空间中建模，仅在决策层融合。在MDD、FEP、PD三个数据集上验证，决策层融合在MDD和FEP上匹配最强单一专家，在PD上超过源分支，FEP上源专家最强。
AI.motivation: 单一疾病概率无法满足闭环神经调控需要，需要具体指定哪些脑区在哪些频率和哪些时间滞后上存在异常。传感器空间模型保留最强诊断证据但缺乏解剖信息，源空间模型提供解剖信息但损失预测信号，后验归因停留在预测外部。
AI.method: 提出DMD-EEG双视图方法：保留固定头皮光谱专家用于诊断，将源空间疾病表示建模为46 ROI×5频率×4滞后（自相关时间尺度）空间中的低秩稀疏迭代变形，健康神经动力学先验。两个专家仅在固定决策层融合，使源状态与头皮专家架构分离。
AI.result: 在MDD、FEP、PD三个数据集上，决策层融合在MDD和FEP上匹配最强单一专家，在PD上超过源分支。FEP上源专家最强。源状态是明确ROI-频率-滞后归因，在不同头皮布局的队列间可迁移，MDD状态可跨蒙太奇转移。最高显著坐标与已知疾病回路对齐（MDD：额叶-边缘-颞叶，PD：运动皮层β频段）。
AI.conclusion: 双视图方法成功分离诊断专家与源空间解剖表示，源状态可作为解剖协调的可预测表示，坐标可直接读取并生成假设，为闭环神经调控提供subject-specific结构化状态。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大规模场景三维高斯溅射(3D-GS)模型训练的资源高效联邦学习框架，通过自适应高斯点剪枝和结构一致性恢复机制，解决边缘设备资源受限、局部模型结构不一致和隐私泄露等挑战。
AI.motivation: 在大规模场景重建中，3D-GS技术因其高渲染效率和质量而受到关注，但在无线边缘训练大规模3D-GS模型面临多重技术挑战：边缘设备通信、计算和GPU内存资源有限；局部模型间的结构不一致影响有效聚合；原始视觉内容和相机参数存在隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 提出两种核心机制：1)设备端模型轻量化机制，自适应选择和剪枝高斯点以平衡渲染质量和训练效率，定量评估不同高斯点的重要性，使用重要性-延迟比准则确定剪枝数量；2)3D-GS模型恢复机制，在不访问私有相机参数的情况下恢复局部模型的结构一致性，实现有效的全局模型聚合。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著加速收敛，保持高渲染质量，与最先进的联邦3D-GS基线相比有效降低训练延迟。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够在大规模场景中高效训练3D-GS模型，在严重资源约束下实现快速收敛、高渲染质量和低延迟的平衡，为边缘计算环境下的三维场景重建提供了可行的联邦学习解决方案。

title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
summary: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 针对语言模型预训练数据选择中质量与多样性之间的根本矛盾，提出了 Leverage Score Sampling (Lev) 方法，通过利用分数迭代选择能最大化嵌入数据行列式体积的样本，在消除矩阵重计算的同时实现可扩展选择。
AI.motivation: 质量过滤虽然经验上有效，但会导致多样性崩溃——偏好与高质量参考语料库（如教育类或问答类数据）相似的文本，系统性地排除代表性不足域的有价值数据；而现有多样化选择方法要么关注覆盖导向目标，要么通过昂贵的协方差矩阵重计算直接优化多样性，缺乏可扩展的有效方法。
AI.method: Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)：利用计算高效的 leverage scores 标准，迭代选择能最大化嵌入数据行列式体积的样本，无需矩阵重计算，实现可扩展的数据选择。
AI.result: 1) 相比强基线 DiSF 实现最高 72 倍加速，Vendi 多样性分数提升 9.2%；2) CommonCrawl 网页数据选择上，在七个下游任务中准确率最高提升 1.31%；3) StarCoderData 上选中的子集.bits-per-byte 相比 DiSF 降低 3.08%；4) 发现质量过滤的跨域崩溃现象：CC 数据用 DCLM-fastText 过滤后未能保留足够的代码相关内容。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果倡导将多样性感知实践整合到质量过滤中，以实现更有效的语言模型预训练数据策展。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS) 任务，利用双耳音频和视频帧来分割发声实例。现有的音视觉分割方法主要在单耳设置下开发，无法区分视觉上相似的同类实例。BiAVIS利用双耳听觉提供的物理空间线索来准确定位声源。
AI.motivation: 现有单耳音视觉分割方法主要依赖跨模态语义对应，无法区分同一语义类的视觉相似实例。人类利用双耳听觉（头部和耳廓引入的耳间差异和方向依赖的声学过滤）提供物理空间线索，受此启发提出BiAVIS任务。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三模态VQA中不可靠辅助文本对答案选择的影响，发现支持干扰项的辅助文本（而非最不事实正确的文本）会造成最大准确率下降（最高53.1%），并提出Textual Reliability Ladder诊断协议和训练-free推理时干预方法。
AI.motivation: 三模态VQA中辅助文本常用于补充视觉和语言输入，但其可靠性难以控制。现有的模态冲突研究未明确不同类型不可靠辅助文本如何在固定图像-问题-选项上下文下影响答案选择。
AI.method: 1.提出Textual Reliability Ladder诊断协议，从图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持三个轴分解辅助文本；2.跨多个数据集（ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA）和多个VLM进行实验；3.提出训练-free推理时干预方法：噪声稳定性转向（noise-stability steering）和动态定位（dynamic grounding）。
AI.result: 支持干扰项的辅助文本导致最大准确率下降（高达53.1%），并将错误集中于特定错误选项上。推理时干预方法可减少重定向错误，同时在忠实文本下保持良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 辅助文本可靠性需从决策层面理解，而非仅从事实正确性角度；推理时干预为更稳健的三模态推理提供了实用路径。

The application domains are entirely different: computer graphics/video motion generation vs. multimodal reasoning/question answering. There is no relevant connection to video generation models (Wanxiang/Seedance), 3D motion generation, or extracting visual features for motion synthesis.

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: KeyRec是一个无需训练的视觉记忆框架，用于解决长视频理解中视觉令牌密集积累导致的计算成本过高问题。该框架通过视觉缓存保留细粒度近期观察，并将历史证据组织成结构化事件库，结合文本路由自适应分配读取预算。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在理解长视频和连续流时面临密集视觉令牌积累问题，导致长上下文推理成本过高。现有无训练方法的视觉令牌选择可能丢失连贯事件证据，且难以区分详细近期观察与长程历史。
AI.method: KeyRec采用查询无关的写入机制：在视觉缓存中保留细粒度近期观察，将历史证据组织成结构化事件库；根据候选事件相对于已存储事件的新颖性进行提议，并通过在线添加-合并-驱逐更新维护；问题到达时，文本路由自适应在近期记忆和事件记忆之间分配固定读取预算，无需重新处理历史帧。支持模块化编码器-投影器VLM和无编码器-投影器的NEO-ov架构。
AI.result: 在四个流式和长视频基准及三种VLM骨干网上，KeyRec仅使用10%的密集解码器视觉令牌预算，在15个设置中获得13个最佳压缩性能；在实时问题上比最强压缩基线高2.21-18.37分；在六个长视频设置中获得五个最佳压缩结果；在每个NEO-ov 2B设置中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: KeyRec作为一个无需训练的长视频理解框架，通过创新的视觉缓存和事件库机制，有效降低了计算成本同时保持了优异的性能表现，为视觉语言模型的长上下文处理提供了高效解决方案。

The research profile is about Computer Graphics focused on 3D motion generation from 2D video priors (using video generation models like Wanxiang/Seedance), while this paper addresses video understanding/streaming for VLMs. No overlap in pain points or methods - this is about video comprehension, not video generation or motion synthesis.

title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.
  To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving.
  Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）多智能体系统在处理渐进式规范任务时的表现。这类任务的特征是用户初始需求不完整，需在推理、工具使用或执行过程中逐步发现和补充。为此，研究者提出了ProgSpec基准测试和RepoMAS框架，后者采用类似开源项目管理的-issue驱动方法，能够记录新发现的需求、冲突和失败，并据此修订任务规范和执行结构。实验表明该方法在多个基准测试上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM多智能体系统大多假设任务需求在执行前已充分明确，但实际场景中用户请求往往不完整，额外需求可能在推理、工具使用或执行过程中才逐渐清晰，这种"渐进式规范任务"缺乏系统性的研究方法。
AI.method: 1）构建ProgSpec基准测试，根据初始请求中明确陈述的需求以及任务证据支持的额外需求来评估最终输出；2）提出RepoMAS框架，采用类似开源项目管理的issue驱动多智能体架构，将新发现的需求、冲突和失败记录为结构化Issue，并用于修订任务规范和执行结构。
AI.result: RepoMAS在ProgSpec及五个现有基准测试上均取得最佳性能。进一步分析表明，其issue驱动修订机制和仓库维护机制对性能提升有持续贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调多智能体系统不仅需要在执行过程中修订"如何解决任务"，还应允许修订任务需求的显式表示，这对于处理渐进式规范任务至关重要。

relevance_reason: This paper is about LLM multi-agent systems for handling progressively specified software development tasks (RepoMAS framework with issue-driven architecture). It has nothing to do with Computer Graphics, video generation models (Wanxiang/Seedance), 3D motion generation, or visual feature extraction. The application domain is completely different - it's about software engineering and task management, not video/3D motion synthesis.

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对高分辨率、高像素维度多物种植物图像的可扩展域内自监督预训练基础模型（MAE + ViT），在超过1000万张多视图植物图像瓦片上预训练，在有限监督和现实下游成像条件下进行密集预测和粗粒度全局特征识别 benchmark，Mean Dice达0.8686，Pooled Dice达0.8959，优于自然图像预训练的MAE。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型在密集特征表示和迁移方面存在领域差距，高分辨率植物成像虽能详细表征植物形态，但密集科学分析受限于昂贵的像素级注释、大图像像素维度和成像条件的大幅变化。
AI.method: 使用ViT骨干的掩码自编码器（MAE）在超过1000万张多视图植物图像瓦片上采用分布式训练进行预训练，对学习到的基础模型表示在细粒度密集预测和粗粒度全局特征识别任务上进行全面基准测试，特别强调有限监督和现实下游成像条件。
AI.result: 域内FM实现Mean Dice 0.8686和Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别比在大规模自然图像数据上预训练的MAE counterpart高0.0694和0.0613；增加预训练规模可产生一致的密集特征迁移改进。
AI.conclusion: 缩放域内自监督预训练可以减少领域差距，并为高像素维度科学成像改善可迁移的密集表示。

While both use ViT/MAE methods, the application domain is entirely different - this is agricultural imaging for plant analysis, not computer graphics for video/motion generation. Does not address any of the specified pain points about video quality control, visual guidance for 3D motion, or 2D-to-3D bridging.

title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
summary: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

AI.tldr: SPARO框架通过联合优化任务指令、可重用技能块和路由规则，解决了语言程序优化中的组件选择和激活时机问题，在五个基准测试和五个工作模型上优于基于提示和基于技能的优化基线。
AI.motivation: 现有优化方法只关注设计空间的一部分（ monolithic prompt或skills），缺乏在失败时决定哪个组件应被更新的原则性机制，也很少在统一框架中优化提示、技能和技能使用策略。
AI.method: 提出SPARO框架，执行受控的反事实评估，将示例效果转换为提示、技能和路由组件的概率责任分布，从中采样一个组件，并应用相应的针对性突变。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试和五个工作模型上，SPARO始终优于基于提示和基于技能的优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅取决于发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定该知识存储在哪里以及何时激活。

It has NO relevance to the research profile which is in Computer Graphics, specifically focused on video generation, 3D motion synthesis, and visual guidance features from 2D videos. The application domains are completely different - this is NLP/LLMs while the research profile is about computer graphics and motion generation. Even the methods (LLM optimization) are unrelated to video generation models (Wanxiang/万相, Seedance) or 3D motion generation.

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CleanSlide基准测试和Pair-DPO训练方法，用于评估病理视觉语言模型(VLM)是否真正利用图像证据而非依赖数据集污染或先验知识。在CleanSlide上，方法比最佳已发布模型提升15.29%的图像证据利用率，在CPTAC和BCNB外部队列分别达到57.6%和59.0%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前病理VLM评估仅使用准确率，无法区分模型是否真正使用图像证据。准确率可能混淆了数据集污染、先验知识和图像证据。研究者发现大多数公开病理VLM在输入整张切片、标注病变区域或完全不输入图像时表现差异极小，说明这些模型可能并未真正利用图像信息。
AI.method: 1. 构建CleanSlide基准测试：基于TCGA，包含149K道经过审核的多选题，覆盖9,985张切片，采用患者和组织来源互斥的划分方式。每道题都审核了选项捷径、题干泄露、跨划分重复和盲解性。2. 提出Pair-DPO方法：对同一问题来源的反事实切片对进行偏好学习，控制共享混杂因素，消除问题相关信号，保留图像证据作为偏好来源。每对由两张具有相反验证结果的真实切片组成，避免编辑伪影和未验证标签。
AI.result: 方法在CleanSlide上从图像证据中获得15.29%的提升，而最佳已发布模型仅获得2.81%。在CPTAC外部队列准确率57.6%，BCNB外部队列59.0%，分别超越其他模型9.7%和3.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过CleanSlide基准测试和Pair-DPO方法，可以有效区分病理VLM是否真正利用图像证据。该方法显著提升了模型对图像证据的利用能力，在多个外部验证队列上展现了优越性能。

This is completely unrelated to the research profile: Computer Graphics, 2D video generation quality control, extracting visual features for 3D motion synthesis. Even though both involve VLMs, the application domain is entirely different - medical diagnosis vs computer graphics/motion generation. The methods (CleanSlide benchmark, Pair-DPO) are designed for medical VLM evaluation, not for video quality supervision or motion generation. No overlap whatsoever.

title: DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents
summary: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM代理系统中组件属性的失败归因问题，提出DAAF框架学习有效属性替换的效果，将干预证据 amortized 到部署时诊断，在不依赖反事实重放或任务奖励的情况下实现80.72%属性Hit@1和71.93%总体任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前失败定位方法可以识别错误在代理或执行追踪中的位置，但修复需要不同的决策：应该修改哪个可编辑的系统资产，以及该变更是否预期改善任务结果？现有方法缺乏将失败定位连接到可执行系统修复的能力。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了文本到图像(TTI)模型在处理 figurative language(比喻语言)时的一个新问题:Figurative Vehicle Intrusion(比喻载体入侵)——即比喻载体本应指导图像描绘,却被错误地渲染为可见物体。作者构建了VISTA多语言基准测试和V-Score评估指标,并提出了VISTA-Guard缓解方法。
AI.motivation: TTI模型虽能生成高质量图像,但在处理 figurative language(比喻语言)时暴露了缺陷:本应指导图像主题描绘的比喻载体(如"狮子"在"勇敢的狮子"中)被错误地渲染为可见的物体,而非隐喻意义。这说明视觉存在并不等于忠实度,现有评估方法会遗漏此类错误。
AI.method: 1) 构建VISTA(Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment)多语言基准测试,按比喻形式和映射机制组织;2) 提出V-Score诊断问答指标,评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实度;3) 开发VISTA-Guard轻量级缓解方法。

AI.conclusion: VISTA基准测试和V-Score指标为系统研究比喻载体入侵问题提供了工具和评估框架,表明当前TTI模型在处理 figurative language方面存在普遍性缺陷,VISTA-Guard作为轻量级缓解方法显示出改进潜力,但仍有提升空间。

title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
summary: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.

AI.tldr: TreeRef提出了一种基于树的分子表示方法，将分子拓扑和局部3D几何绑定到可变大小的树结构上，并基于此开发了TreeRef-BFN（贝叶斯流网络），使用标准Transformer骨干网络，能够通过掩码机制支持无条件生成和可变尺寸结构条件3D生成，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 现有3D分子生成方法存在以下问题：1）预先采样分子大小并生成笛卡尔坐标，限制了可变尺寸条件任务（如片段补全和支架装饰）；2）通常依赖等变架构；3）内部坐标方法虽避免刚体冗余，但通常需要已知分子图或自回归构建，可能累积误差。
AI.method: 1. 提出TreeRef树形分子表示：将分子拓扑和拓扑依赖的局部3D几何分配给可变尺寸树；RingRef节点编码环闭合并保持树结构；Null节点允许分子大小直接从节点占用中涌现。2. 开发TreeRef-BFN：基于TreeRef的贝叶斯流网络，使用标准Transformer骨干网络，全球耦合局部定义的离散分子变量和连续局部几何。3. 单个预训练模型通过掩码支持无条件生成和可变尺寸结构条件3D生成，无需 retraining。
AI.result: 实验表明：1）化学有效性高；2）分子稳定性好；3）多样性好；4）局部几何分布准确；5）采样速度快；6）属性条件生成具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TreeRef-BFN是一个高效灵活的3D分子生成框架，能够联合建模分子大小、拓扑和几何，支持可变尺寸条件生成任务，在化学有效性、稳定性、多样性和属性条件生成方面表现出色。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: MOXAI是一个深度学习框架，整合DNA甲基化和拷贝数变异数据对成人型弥漫性胶质瘤进行分子亚型分类，同时开发了基于CAM和Grad-CAM的可解释AI方法。
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型通常分别分析甲基化和拷贝数变异数据，无法捕获整合信息提供的补充信息；当前分类模型缺乏类似传统肿瘤分级的类内风险评估机制，且没有可解释性方法能将分类决策归因于特定基因组位点。
AI.method: 使用TCGA队列训练ResNet50、DINOv2和图注意力网络(GAT)模型，分别基于甲基化数据、拷贝数数据和组合多模态数据；开发基于类激活映射(CAM)和梯度加权CAM(Grad-CAM)的XAI方法识别相关CpG位点、基因和染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型达到92.98%交叉验证准确率，优于仅用拷贝数数据的模型；DINOv2在独立验证集上表现最强，达到94.25%准确率(置信度>0.9)；XAI结果与成人型弥漫性胶质瘤亚型的已知分子特征一致。
AI.conclusion: MOXAI框架成功整合多模态数据实现高精度分类，可解释AI方法确认了框架的生物学可解释性，为胶质瘤分子亚型分类提供了新工具。
